description: Parkings vélos - Arrondissement de Liège is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Liège Métropole. Coordonnées cartographiques du réseau de parkings vélos sur le territoire de l'Arrondissement de Liège. Données récoltées auprès des 24 Villes et Communes du territoire. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Mobility. Its keywords are MOBILITY IN LIEGE METROPOLE. The portal shows 1,267 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-10-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
